description.narrative: Agronomika will receive a blended farmer finance facility, that consists of a long term loan from FMO (Massif-fund) which is supported by a first loss guarantee of IDH. Both FMO and IDH support Kennemer’s operations with technical assistance whereby IDH’s focus is on the farmer engagement model and FMO’s support is aimed at improving governance and risk management of Agronomika. The blended farmer finance facility will be utilized to provide microloans to farmers for long term investments in their cocoa farms. The facility is structured under the Smallholder Finance Facility, the cooperation between FMO and IDH (http://smallholder.finance/).
